test_name: 1. Hard filter strict pass returns >= 6 candidates matching runtime, brainBattery, crewFit, and mood
2. Relaxation steps 1, 2, 3 and < 6 survivors fallback always return a playable candidate pool
3. Group Least-Misery scoring applies 0.6 * min + 0.4 * mean and removes vetoed films for all players
4. Rule of 3 returns at most 3 films with 3 distinct primary genres when possible
5. Backup Reel ("20-Minute Rule") picks a shorter, faster-hook, lower-or-equal battery film in a different primary genre
6. Night Log learning updates genre weights (+2 loved, +1 finished, -2 bailed) and drops patience on early bail
7. Corrupted localStorage JSON recovers gracefully to factory defaults without throwing
8. Time-Fit back-solved timeline and Double Feature selection respect runtime budgets
